text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text:
＜Fortitude＞
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. Then, 1 of their Digimon or Tamers can't unsuspend in their next unsuspend phase.
[All Turns] This Digimon is also treated as Lv.6 [Breakdramon] for [Examon]'s DNA digivolution.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your Digimon with [Dracomon] or [Examon] in their texts delete your opponent's Digimon in battle, trash their top security card.

qa.question: What kind of card does "a card with X in its text" refer to?
qa.answer:
It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, (Rule), digivolve requirements, DNA Digivolve, DigiXros requirements, Burst Digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements.
For example, "a card with [Knightmon] in its text" would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

qa.question: What kind of card does the text "[AA] or [BB] in its text" refer to?
qa.answer: It checks if that card has [AA] or [BB] in its text.

qa.question: Can this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect give "can't unsuspend" to a different card than the one it suspended?
Can I use on [BT20-045 Examon ACE] to DNA digivolve this card in my hand by using its [All Turns] effect to treat it as [Breakdramon]?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
This [All Turns] effect only activates while this card is in the battle area. It isn't treated as [Breakdramon] in the hand.
Related Cards

qa.question: Can I activate this card's inherited effect when an opponent's Digimon and the specified Digimon are deleted at the same time?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can.
However, if the specified Digimon has this card as a digivolution card, and it and the opponent's Digimon are both deleted at the same time, the effect can't activate.
